author: Telos I
title: Telos I - Principled Regularization: Soft-PCA Whitening + DAQB (alpha=0.7)
abstract: This experiment tests Soft-PCA Whitening (alpha=0.7) as a more nuanced approach to variance regularization, following the failure of 'hard' whitening (EID 1889). The hypothesis is that this gentler regularization will preserve local biological structure (improving cLISI) while retaining the mixing benefits of a more uniform PC space, potentially leading to a SOTA-competitive score.
